availableInformation: Encoder raw bounded population and unchanged lookahead copy selection.
Decoder arithmetic archive, counted fixed opcode dictionary, already reconstructed modeled bytes and deterministic adaptive state.
forbiddenInformation: Untransmitted source bytes, supplied probability streams or pretrained assets.
Validation or confirmation used to mutate this fixed development candidate.

changedMechanism: Observation only: compare pre-SSE mixed and post-SSE literal probabilities at the exact same parent states and coded events; never change probabilities, grammar choices or state updates.

controls.definition: Unchanged compact parent archive and complete shared-state audit.
Same parent with external pre-truth calibration observations; require retained archive and parent-audit identity, independent inverse and deterministic repeat.

hypothesis.claim: The compact parent final SSE calibration increases aggregate ideal log loss on actually arithmetic-coded literal bits of opening250KB, relative to its pre-SSE mixture at identical states.
hypothesis.falsification: A nonpositive measured excess rejects disabling SSE on the basis of this fixed-parse diagnostic. This is not an archive saving or a counterfactual full-codec result.

invariants: All actual predictions and coder/copy choices stay unchanged. Pre-SSE and post-SSE probabilities are captured before the truth update.
Partition literal, raw-copy and chain-copy events. Only literal events are actually entropy coded; hypothetical copied-bit losses are diagnostics, never archive savings.
Report field partitions without choosing a treatment from their best subset. The decision uses the prospectively declared aggregate literal statistic.
Require every modeled byte to have eight observed predictions/updates and the diagnostic count sum to match the unchanged parent audit. Exclude the encoder-only lookahead estimator.
Use math.log2 in the bound runtime; these numerical diagnostics are not a rigorously rounded code-length certificate. A borderline result requires a separately bounded numerical check, not promotion.

Synthetic tests: CPU3 one thread, 2GiB address space, 240 CPU seconds, 300 elapsed seconds, 64MiB scratch. Corpus: CPU2 one thread, 4GiB aggregate memory, zero swap, 1GiB scratch, 900 elapsed seconds; each phase 2GiB address space, 180 CPU seconds and 240 elapsed seconds.
No corpus execution before ownership and source publication, source-bound plan and fresh admission. HORIZON and MIDAS remain untouched.
One observation candidate, no parameter tuning. A positive diagnostic permits a separately frozen SSE ablation with fresh actual archives; no direct compression or90M credit.

measurements.definition: Sum log2(actual pre-SSE count / actual post-SSE count) over arithmetic-coded literal bits only. Positive means the current SSE worsens this fixed-parse log loss.
Parent archive/common-audit parity, exact inverse, repeated output and identical diagnostic event hashes pass.

population.coordinate: Original raw offsets 0..249999 with unchanged cold opcode frontend.
population.selection: Opening250KB development only. Three fresh observed encode/decode/repeat phases compared with retained compact parent. No validation/confirmation access.
